annotations.title: Mobile home park loan program rules

description: The published rules for financing a mobile home park (manufactured housing community) under Fannie Mae MHC, Freddie Mac Optigo MHC, HUD Section 223(f) MHC and SBA 7(a)/504: max LTV, min DSCR, amortization, minimum size, occupancy, park-owned home caps, borrower eligibility, reserves and mortgage insurance, each with its primary source and date. SBA comes back as not eligible, with the SOP quote.

program.description: fannie, freddie, hud, sba, or all (default).
